_doc: Shared test table for marks that hold on to words: nexus renderer/src/board/anchor.js and nexus-mobile NexusCore Anchor.swift must both pass it. Positions are UTF-16 offsets. want null = a ghost (ghost = where it waits). make: makeAnchor(text, from, to) must give at.
